name: Chidy Ejike
headline: Turning business complexity into clear, practical solutions.
intro: I work across discovery, requirements, process improvement and delivery to help teams build solutions that solve real business problems. I specialise in translating business needs into clear requirements and practical digital solutions.
about: My work brings together stakeholder engagement, business process modelling, requirements engineering and collaborative delivery. I focus on understanding the problem before defining the solution, and creating clear artefacts that help teams make decisions.
